atlas_dictionary_suggestions_decision_ch.name: atlas_dictionary_suggestions_decision_check
atlas_dictionary_suggestions_decision_ch.value:
("atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."state" = 'waiting' and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_by" is null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_at" is null)
        or ("atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."state" = 'withdrawn' and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_by" is null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_at" is not null)
        or ("atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."state" = 'approved' and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_by" is not null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_at" is not null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."reason" is null)
        or ("atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."state" = 'rejected' and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_by" is not null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."decided_at" is not null and "atlas_dictionary_suggestions"."reason" is not null)

atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes_stage_c.name: atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes_stage_check
atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes_stage_c.value: ("atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes"."stage_before" is null or "atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes"."stage_before" in ('sampling', 'in-production')) and ("atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes"."stage_after" is null or "atlas_manufacturer_stage_changes"."stage_after" in ('sampling', 'in-production'))
